'''Thorn Gorge Emissaries''' are blood elven [[Thorn Gorge]] recruiters located at various spots throughout the largest Alliance and Horde cities - [[Stormwind City]], [[Ironforge]], [[Darnassus]], [[Orgrimmar]], [[Thunder Bluff]], and [[Undercity]], during the weekly battleground holiday event for Thorn Gorge.

==Quotes==
;High enough level character
The Call to Arms rings loud in Thorn Gorge. Answer it... or be forgotten like so many before you.
